The counts are finite exact claims; no infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The main source explicitly leaves q=2 outside its theorem and asks whether it can be included. The first planar quadratic instance is a natural smallest missing case, and the new theorem goes beyond an existence example to a complete finite geometric and arithmetic classification: 1344 points, eight free projective orbits, two Galois-projective types, and 224 Galois sextuples. This records concrete finite-field interpolation geometry that can guide later binary extensions. It is not an arbitrary numerical slice or a renaming of an established result.
